info.title: mdcat
info.description: A 'cat' for Markdown — render Markdown files (and stdin) to styled terminal output: headings, lists, code blocks, OSC 8 hyperlinks, and LaTeX math (sixel/sextant/half-block).

options.name: --mode
options.description:
unicode | sixel | sextant | halfblock.
Default: auto-detect (sixel on capable
terminals, sextant otherwise).

options.name: --color
options.description:
truecolor | 16 | none. Default: auto-detect
(truecolor + modern palette on capable
terminals; honours NO_COLOR).

options.name: --width
options.description: Render width. Default: console width or 80.

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: The markdown file to render. Use '-' for stdin.
